# Biyo POS

> > Biyo POS is an affordable, cloud-based point-of-sale solution designed for small to medium-sized businesses across retail, food service, and specialized industries.

Biyo POS provides industry-specific POS systems with integrated payment processing, inventory management, and business analytics. The platform supports contactless payments via NFC, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay, with offline functionality for uninterrupted operations.

## Key Topics

- Point-of-Sale System
- Payment Processing
- Contactless Payments
- Inventory Management
- Cloud-Based POS
- Sales Analytics
- NFC Technology
- Mobile Payments
- Barcode Scanning
- Offline Mode
- Restaurant POS
- Retail Management
- Business Analytics
- Free Card Processing

## Core Platform

- [Point of Sale for Small to Medium-Size Businesses](https://biyopos.com): Biyo POS: affordable point-of-sale solution for small to medium businesses
- [Free Card Processing and Free POS Software - Biyo POS](https://biyopos.com/free-card-processing): Biyo POS free card processing and payment terminal solution
